To Whom It May Concern,  

I have worked directly with Anya Kowalski for over three years as her manager at EcoCart Solutions, a large-scale e-commerce startup. In this role, she has consistently demonstrated reliability, adaptability, and a strong ability to balance technical execution with cross-functional collaboration.  

Anya’s technical expertise lies in building and scaling microservices architectures that support high-traffic retail platforms. She designed a microservices-based system for inventory management that reduced latency by 40% during peak seasons, enabling the team to handle a 2x increase in user load without compromising performance. Her proficiency in Go and Python has been critical to this work, particularly in developing asynchronous backend services that integrate with third-party logistics APIs. She also led the migration of a monolithic checkout system to a modular REST API structure, which improved maintainability and allowed for faster feature rollouts.  

Beyond technical skills, Anya’s strength lies in her collaborative approach. She frequently mentors junior engineers and takes initiative to simplify complex workflows, such as automating data analysis tasks with Python scripts that saved the team 15 hours monthly. Her ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders has been instrumental in aligning engineering efforts with business goals.  

Anya is a dependable team player who consistently meets deadlines while prioritizing quality. I am confident she will bring the same level of dedication and problem-solving acumen to her next role.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
Senior Engineering Manager, EcoCart Solutions
